caption: The video captures a coastal seascape at sunset, seen from the beach under a sky of orange, yellow and teal clouds above a flat horizon. A low line of breaking surf holds its position in the mid-distance. Its crest texture shifts subtly along a persistent line. In the foreground, a wide sheet of wet sand mirrors the sky's warm and cool tones, the reflections changing as a thin film of water moves over them. The foam edge between the darker water band and the reflective sand drifts gradually toward the viewer, the swash creeping slowly up the beach. The framing appears steady, with the horizon and cloud pattern largely unchanged. The clouds show little visible movement. The water sheet continues its slow advance.
